mapper.update: UPDATE task_step SET status = 'SCHEDULING', dispatch_token = #{dispatchToken}, version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'WAITING_RESOURCE' AND dispatch_token IS NULL
UPDATE task_step SET status = 'WAITING_RESOURCE', dispatch_token = NULL, version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SCHEDULING' AND dispatch_token = #{dispatchToken}
UPDATE task_step SET mutex_holder = #{holder}, mutex_group = #{mutexGroup}, version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND dispatch_token = #{dispatchToken}

UPDATE task_step SET status = 'RETRYING', next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, retry_count = retry_count + 1, fail_reason = #{failReason}, version = version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
